name: Kuon
source:
An apothecary with ears and tail like an animal's. Separated from her homeland, she encounters [url=/c37791]Haku[/url] while traveling along leisurely. 

She gets excited when it comes to bathing and often ends her sentences with "-かな～" or, in English, "I think".

[spoiler]She is the daughter of [url=/c411]Hakuoro[/url] and [url=/c415]Yuzuha[/url].[/spoiler]
